we identified Smad1/Smad5 binding sites in human pulmonary artery endothelial cells (HPAECs) and human lung fibroblasts (HLFs), and found that Smad1/ Smad5 preferentially bind to the region outside of known genes, with binding patterns determined mostly by differences in baseline chroma tin accessibility patterns in the two cell types.

the mechanism of the regulation of the expression of target genes of the BMP signaling pathway in endothelial cells and smooth muscle cells.

the identification of Smad1 and Smad5 binding sites and the characterization of Smad1,5 target genes in endothelial cells and pulmonary arterial smooth muscles, which will contribute to the understanding of the molecular mechanism of bone morphogenetic proteins signaling.
